note: Ways out of what a check finds: options to look at, not rules (CONTRIBUTING.md, 四个绑定点: a check reports, a tool offers, the film decides). Keyed by a finding's kind (tools/checkrec.py lists them). bin/vh check prints the ones for the kinds it found that are not confirmed, and each finding in its record carries them as remedies. An entry: say (one line: what it is for), and run (a bin/vh command, as typed) or doc (a file in the repo, #section). tools/remedies.py check (tools/ci.sh) holds the table to its rules: each kind one checkrec.py writes or one named in kinds_to_come, each run a real command, each recipes filter finding at least one recipe, each doc there.

kinds_to_come.check.loudness: the whole film's loudness, line A's addition to bin/vh check (batch 1): whichever of the two lands second makes the kind's name agree

check.static.say: a still stretch nobody meant: a breath shot that keeps moving
or a slow push or drift over the hold

check.freeze.say: a frozen picture nobody meant: a breath shot that keeps moving
a frozen stretch in a render that should move: draw it again

check.black.say: a black meant as a chapter break: a black card that reads, with a sound bed under it
a black nobody meant: look at the frames there

check.silence.say: no digital silence in a film with sound: a quiet bed (ambience, room tone) under the hush
and mix it in at its level

check.cut.say: a hard cut from dark to bright flashes: a seam that carries the light up
or dim the bright side a step, or fade up from the dark over a few frames

check.iso.say: a capture glitch: draw those frames again, the rest kept
why single frames go bad, and the HyperFrames flags against it

check.blind.say: too busy to judge from motion alone: look at the frames

check.subtitles.say: a subtitle shorter than its reading time: cut the lines again from the narration's timing
and the on-screen words held long enough to read

check.colour.say: the colour tags a platform reads: the re-encode command
check.colour.doc: playbook/02-verification.md#色彩标签每个-mp4-出片前查一次

check.spec.say: the size, rate or length the BRIEF names: render it again to the spec

check.gate.say: gate ① not on record: stop and put the concept cards to the person

check.packaging.say: the publishing copy over a platform's limit: the lengths and how to cut

check.scale.say: a 4K render whose layout moved: what reads pixel sizes at device scale 2

check.loudness.say: the film's loudness off its target: mix it again to the platform's level (lufs=, tp=)
